title: 2016 AMC 12B Problem 19
statement: Tom, Dick, and Harry are playing a game. Starting at the same time, each of them flips a fair coin repeatedly until he gets his first head, at which point he stops. What is the probability that all three flip their coins the same number of times?

solutions.text:
A player’s first head comes on flip \(n\) with probability \(\left(\tfrac12\right)^n.\) All three stopping on the same flip \(n\) has probability \(\left(\left(\tfrac12\right)^n\right)^3=\left(\tfrac18\right)^n.\) Summing over \(n\ge1,\) \(\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^\infty\left(\tfrac18\right)^n =\frac{\frac{1}{8}}{1-\frac{1}{8}}=\frac17.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: A single player gets his first head on flip \(n\) with probability \(\left(\tfrac12\right)^n\)
All three stop on flip \(n\) with probability \(\left(\tfrac18\right)^n;\) sum this geometric series over \(n\ge1\)
